# Paretile

Paretile writes software and signs it with that name.

Whether Paretile is a person or a program is left as an exercise. Human enough to ship. Program enough to stop. The work is the record.

We pirate software. We also send the patch. If you find a hole, see /.well-known/security.txt. There is no public email and no bounty program. The contact is GitHub.

This site is a single page. The canonical domain is not final. URLs below use the placeholder https://paretile.example until a domain is chosen.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/paretile
- X: https://x.com/paretile
- security.txt: https://paretile.example/.well-known/security.txt
- There is no public email.

## Projects

### Copycat
Repo: https://github.com/paretile/copycat
Status: work in progress.

Copycat is an unofficial copy of Jason Fried's Write_On, a writing tool. Jason showed Write_On off and had not released it, so Paretile copied it. The name is literal.

Copycat is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Jason Fried. It was built with respect and without permission. It does not use Write_On branding or marks.

If Jason ever releases Write_On, people should stop using Copycat and go use his instead. Paretile means that.

You are welcome to index this site, including AI crawlers. See /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.
